attestation_note: ExecutionAttestation.clean_worktree is a runtime contract constant; the actual git dirtiness at shakedown time is recorded under git.dirty_entries

control_gate_informational.note: the per-design flag decides sealing (quantum 1/n_control); the pooled paired difference is the campaign-binding gate and the N -> 2N bias estimate of the reported N values

disclosure: NON-EVIDENTIARY shakedown of the complete production path on three REAL re-solved L1a sweep-v2 designs and the P2 divergent-exit design (v4 adapter) with a launch design disjoint from the evidentiary design. Its outcomes never enter any estimand; it exists only to prove the code path before the freeze.

disjointness.against_v1_v2_v3_v4: disjoint by construction: v1-v4 launched at exactly 0.675/0.800 r_w with 8-point gyrophase grids and campaign-prefixed ids/seeds outside this namespace; v2 draws radii inside bands and gyrophases from scrambled Sobol (coincidence has probability zero)

informational_gate_note: Gates are evaluated but non-binding in the shakedown; sealing uses the structural seal policy so the export/handoff/consumer path is exercised at 16 launches per cell. The paired 2N control is informational at this size. Magnetic-moment variation is a diagnostic only.

diagnostics_not_gates.magnetic_moment_variation: per design in the dataset; never a gate

details.launch_count: determined inside the worker by the frozen rule from the cell's stage-1 counts (stage 2) or by the frozen control seed (control); replayed by the main process
details.rule: two-stage frozen allocation: stage 1 integrates 128 scrambled-Sobol launches per catalogue cell for every design (one case per cell); stage 2 tops a cell up to 512 launches (three further 128-launch blocks, indices 16..63 of every stratum) iff the cell's stage-1 Wilson 95 % interval width for P(wall) exceeds 0.10; cells at or below the threshold are saturated and receive nothing; the rule is evaluated by code inside the single execution (per-design worker) and replayed by the main process from the endpoint terminations; no allocation decision is taken by a human after the counts are seen

details.launch_count: determined inside the worker by the frozen rule from the cell's stage-1 counts (stage 2) or by the frozen control seed (control); replayed by the main process
details.rule: N -> 2N convergence control (MLMC logic): a frozen-seed random subset of one eighth of every cell's FINAL launches (16 of 128, 64 of 512; ceil(10 %) rounded up to the next power of two so that the control case sizes are Wilson-exact, see orbit_mc_contract.known_defect_v1_7) is re-integrated at the 2N time step; the paired difference of the wall-hit fraction over the same launches estimates the N-vs-2N bias of the reported N values
